lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਰਿਦ ਭਇਅੰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gun rama(n)t dookh naasahi rid bhaia(n)t saa(n)t ||3||
lines.translation: Uttering His Glorious Praises, suffering is eradicated, and the heart becomes tranquil and calm. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mritaa ras peeu rasanaa naanak har ra(n)g raat ||4||4||15||
lines.translation: Drink in the Sweet, Sublime Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, and be imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||4||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਆਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajanaa sa(n)t aau merai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O friends, O Saints, come to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਸਮਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aanadaa gun gaai ma(n)gal kasamalaa mit jaahi parerai ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with pleasure and joy, the sins will be erased and thrown away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਧਰਉ ਮਾਥੈ ਚਾਂਦਨਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t charan dharau maathai chaa(n)danaa grihi hoi a(n)dherai ||2||
lines.translation: Touch your forehead to the feet of the Saints, and your dark household shall be illumined. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad kamal bigasai gobi(n)d bhajau pekh nerai ||3||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and see Him near at hand. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਹ ਬੇਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kripaa te sa(n)t paae vaar vaar naanak uh berai ||4||5||16||
lines.translation: By the Grace of God, I have found the Saints. Over and over again, Nanak is a sacrifice to that moment. ||4||5||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran gopaal teree ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਧੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh maan dhoh bharam raakh leejai kaat beree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Save me from emotional attachment, pride, deception and doubt; please cut away these ropes which bind me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: boodat sa(n)saar saagar ||
lines.translation: I am drowning in the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: udhare har simar ratanaagar ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Source of Jewels, I am saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetalaa har naam teraa ||
lines.translation: Your Name, Lord, is cooling and soothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: poorano thaakur prabh meraa ||2||
lines.translation: God, my Lord and Master, is Perfect. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen darad nivaar taaran ||
lines.translation: You are the Deliverer, the Destroyer of the sufferings of the meek and the poor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har kripaa nidh patit udhaaran ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Treasure of Mercy, the Saving Grace of sinners. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੂਖ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot janam dookh kar paaio ||
lines.translation: I have suffered the pains of millions of incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sukhee naanak gur naam driRaaio ||4||6||17||
lines.translation: Nanak is at peace; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||4||6||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan uh preet charan sa(n)g laagee ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that love, which is attuned to the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot jaap taap sukh paae aai mile pooran badabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The peace which comes from millions of chants and deep meditations is obtained by perfect good fortune and destiny. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath daas jan teraa avar ot sagalee mohi tiaagee ||
lines.translation: I am Your helpless servant and slave; I have given up all other support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਰ ਭਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhor bharam kaate prabh simarat giaan a(n)jan mil sovat jaagee ||1||
lines.translation: Every trace of doubt has been eradicated, remembering God in meditation. I have applied the ointment of spiritual wisdom, and awakened from my sleep. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਤਨਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too athaahu at bado suaamee kripaa si(n)dh pooran ratanaagee ||
lines.translation: You are Unfathomably Great and Utterly Vast, O my Lord and Master, Ocean of Mercy, Source of Jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachak har har naam maa(n)gai masatak aan dhario prabh paagee ||2||7||18||
lines.translation: Nanak, the beggar, begs for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he rests his forehead upon God's Feet. ||2||7||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਪਟ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuchil kathor kapat kaamee ||
lines.translation: I am filthy, hard-hearted, deceitful and obsessed with sexual desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahi tiu taar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please carry me across, as You wish, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too samarath saran jog too raakhahi apanee kal dhaar ||1||
lines.translation: You are All-powerful and Potent to grant Sanctuary. Exerting Your Power, You protect us. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaap taap nem such sa(n)jam naahee in bidhe chhutakaar ||
lines.translation: Chanting and deep meditation, penance and austere self-discipline, fasting and purification - salvation does not come by any of these means.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: garat ghor a(n)dh te kaadhahu prabh naanak nadar nihaar ||2||8||19||
lines.translation: Please lift me up and out of this deep, dark ditch; O God, please bless Nanak with Your Glance of Grace. ||2||8||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaraain narapat namasakaarai ||
lines.translation: The one who bows in humble reverence to the Primal Lord, the Lord of all beings

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aise gur kau bal bal jaaeeai aap mukat mohi taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to such a Guru; He Himself is liberated, and He carries me across as well. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan kavan gun kaheeai a(n)t nahee kachh paarai ||
lines.translation: Which, which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I chant? There is no end or limitation to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਕਈ ਕੋਰੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਐਸੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laakh laakh laakh kaee korai ko hai aiso beechaarai ||1||
lines.translation: There are thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, many millions of them, but those who contemplate them are very rare. ||1||
